title: Powerhouse docs ship as llms.txt / llms-full.txt and as a Context7 library
content:
The academy follows the [llms.txt standard](https://llmstxt.org) and publishes two machine-readable artifacts at the site root:

| File | Purpose | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://academy.vetra.io/llms.txt` | Navigation index — links to every doc page with a short description | ~22KB |
| `https://academy.vetra.io/llms-full.txt` | All documentation concatenated for full-context ingestion | ~1MB |

Three consumption paths are documented:

- **Context7** — search `powerhouse-inc/powerhouse` or use library id `/powerhouse-inc/powerhouse`, then `use context7` in Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, etc.
- **Paste the URL** — dropping `https://academy.vetra.io/llms-full.txt` into a Claude or ChatGPT message loads the whole corpus at once.
- **`curl`** either file for programmatic access.

The size split is the practical bit. The ~22KB index fits comfortably in a prompt and is a page directory, so it is the right artifact for "which doc covers X" routing; the ~1MB full corpus is for one-shot ingestion when you want everything and can afford the context.

One caveat that matters when relying on these: the files are **generated from the academy source docs** by `scripts/generate-llm-docs.ts` (`npm run generate:llm-docs`), writing `static/llms.txt` and `static/llms-full.txt` for Docusaurus to serve. So they are a snapshot at generation time, and they inherit whatever staleness the source pages carry — including Docusaurus-published pages whose guidance has drifted from the shipped code. They are a fast index, not an authority.

Provenance: academy `05-Lookup/02-LLMDocs.md`, academy 6.2.2-dev.45.
